chunk_view_0.name: chunk_view_0
chunk_view_0.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  -- include building-level square footage columns (to be aggregated later if needed)
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER,
  b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM buildings b
WHERE b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
chunk_view_0.description: Task: For each building key, produce a row containing the building name, the name(s) of HR department(s) occupying that building, the building's total gross square footage, the building's total assign

chunk_view_1.name: chunk_view_1
chunk_view_1.body_sql:
SELECT
  FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  DATE_BUILT,
  EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  -- include HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME from employee_directory which links via OFFICE_LOCATION to building number; keep join keys for later
  -- include NUM_OF_ROOMS in case "unit" refers to rooms; keep other building identifiers for joins
  NUM_OF_ROOMS,
  BUILDING_NUMBER,
  COST_COLLECTOR_KEY,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_building
WHERE FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL

chunk_view_2.name: chunk_view_2
chunk_view_2.body_sql:
SELECT
  FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  BUILDING_ROOM AS BUILDING_NAME,
  FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  ORGANIZATION_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  AREA AS ASSIGNABLE_SQFT,
  ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  FLOOR,
  LATITUDE_WGS,
  LONGITUDE_WGS,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fclt_rooms
WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
